result:
I made all 17 planned changes in the 13 granted files, but the round is not ready to pass. The code review found fields that K0 should have caught, so under K0's stop rule this goes back to B for a re-grant. Nothing was reverted. Full report: `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-194.md`, evidence in `a-round-194/`.

**Why it stops at K0:**
- **GuestForm on `/support`** (`chat/GuestForm.tsx:67` and `:91`): the name and email fields still use the faint border. Signed-out visitors see them, and they measure **1.21:1** in the browser.
- **Recordings tools** (`SfxSoundLibrary.tsx:68`, `SfxSceneBuilder.tsx:112`, `SfxVideoSync.tsx:25`, `SfxQuickEdit.tsx:183`): four class constants style fields on the darkest background. These routes need the backend, so I did not measure them. B may decide `recordings/` counts as Studio.
- **Why the scan missed them:** the 14-line window actually covers the tag plus 13 lines, and GuestForm's token is on the 14th line after the tag. The scan also doesn't follow class constants. B's `fieldscan.mjs` has the same two gaps.
- **Not fixed:** none of these files are granted, so I didn't touch them.

**What changed:**
- **Placeholder:** the LeadMagnet email placeholder is now `placeholder:text-brand-foreground/60`. Nothing else in that file changed.
- **Field borders:** all 16 fields F1–F16 now use `border-outline-strong`, one token per site. Biome forced no reflows.
- **F1 fallback:** not needed. The newsletter field reads at least 3.11:1 at 1440, 1280 and 375.
- **Tests:** `store-theme-tokens.test.ts` gains ST7, ST8 (all 16 sites) and ST8b. ST1–ST6 are unchanged.
- **Doc 158:** status updated and a Georgian Round 194 section added. I also corrected two things it got wrong: the missed fields, and F16, which does appear on `/support` once a chat session exists.

**Checks I ran:**
- **Token test:** 24/24 pass on the tree. On the start copies, ST7, all 16 ST8 cases and ST8b fail while ST1–ST6 pass. Mutants m10–m13 each fail the test B specified.
- **Neighbour suites:** 48/48 pass. The e2e specs don't depend on any changed class.
- **Typecheck, lint, Biome:** typecheck has 0 errors. Lint shows 214 warnings and 1 info, the same as round 193. Biome on the changed files has 0 errors; its 26 warnings are also in the start copies.
- **Not run:** full suite, build, verify and e2e, which belong to the gate.

**Browser proof** (Playwright, mock API on :5199, which I started and stopped by its own PID):

| Field | Lowest edge ratio |
|---|---|
| F1 newsletter | 3.11 |
| F2 store search | 3.64 |
| F3–F6 hire-us | 3.70 |
| F7 free-downloads | 3.50 |
| F8 gift cards | 3.30 |
| F14 sign-in modal | 3.50 |

- **Focus:** every field I reached by keyboard shows the brass border.
- **Placeholder:** 5.1:1, against 21:1 for the typed value.
- **`/studio-lab`:** at 1440, 0 changed pixels against the round-191 reference. The first load hit the known Vite first-load glitch and I re-ran it once.
- **Not measured:** F9/F10 don't render with an empty cart, F11–F13 need a signed-in user, and F15/F16 weren't measured.

**Unresolved review findings:**
- **High:** the missed fields above.
- **Medium:** ST8b misses both of those layouts. I left it as B specified, because tightening it now would fail on files I can't change. The reviewer's suggested design is in the report.
- **Lows:** four test-robustness points, listed in the report.
- **Architecture note:** passed to B word for word. The test file now has two directory scanners; the reviewer says keep it for now and decide together with `ARCH-R193-THEME-REGION` at the STORE-2 exit.

**For B:**
- Re-grant GuestForm's two fields.
- Rule on `recordings/`.
- Rebuild ST8b in that same round so it fails on these fields before they are fixed.
- Fix `fieldscan.mjs`: a 15-line window, and follow class constants.
- **Next C checks:** C should re-measure F1 at 1280, since it is the tightest case. C should also add GuestForm on `/support`, which is expected to fail until it is re-granted.

STORE-2a is not done from this round.
